svg.title: Solaris design language — foundations
svg.text: Foundations · colour, type, grid, the notch, material
One accent, used sparingly. Warm graphite surfaces separated by tone, not by outlines. Pixel-true geometry. The world stays the hero.
Amber on-colour text is onAmber #1A1206 (9.3:1). Amber covers ≤5% of any screen. Containers never get amber borders, glows or gradients. Status is never colour-only: icon + word always.
Launcher · dashboard · web — IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono (SIL OFL 1.1, Latin + Cyrillic)
Downloads game content from Mojang and the server.
Подключиться к серверу · Скачивание файлов игры
Sentence case everywhere. No ALL-CAPS labels or buttons. Tabular numerals for bytes, ms, %, counts. Max line 72ch.
In game — the vanilla font only (shown with Solaris Pixel stand-in, 3×)
Launcher: 4 px base. Gutter 24. Controls 36 ordinary,
40–44 primary/safety, 32 icon buttons; dense rows only ≥8 px apart.
In game: GUI px. Gaps 2/4/6/8. Controls 20 tall (vanilla rhythm).
Option rows 18. Icons 16. Panel inner margin 8. Whole GUI pixels only.
Action bar 72 · status left · one primary right
Launcher 980×620 default (min 820×540). Sidebar removed: the top bar frees width for the list.
One unit cut from every corner:
1 GUI px in game, 2 px in the launcher.
Elevation is tone only: no shadow, blur,
glow or gradient fill. Modal scrim ink0 72%.
In-game panels ink1 at 94% — opaque enough to read.
Focus = 2 px amber ring, 2 px offset.
Selection = 3 px bar + ink3. Never the same geometry.
Sound: one quiet click on an accepted action (vanilla UI click category, obeys volume). No hover sounds, no toast chimes. Every sound has a visible equivalent.
DesignOpus · 2026-10-23 · tokens are proposals for implementation slices, not shipped values.
